o: How f changes as x changes, with y held fixed
why: A partial derivative moves one variable at a time and treats the others as constants.
3y doesn't depend on x, so it counts as a constant and its derivative is 0. ∂f/∂x = 2xy.

q: ∂f/∂x = 0 at a point means f doesn't change at all near it.
why: Myth. It only means no change along the x direction. f can still change as y changes.

q: The marginal product of labour ∂Q/∂L is 4. What does that mean?
o: One more unit of labour, with capital fixed, adds about 4 to output
why: It's marginal analysis with the other inputs held still.
